_doc: Evidence recorded by people/agents about sources that look quiet or are not covered. A quiet source is only called QUIET when a content probe of the live feed (not the database) shows no newer item than the newest one collected; otherwise it is UNVERIFIED. Gaps are sectors with no authoritative collection method. priority_sources: AU/critical-infrastructure authoritative sources (word-boundary, case-insensitive match on source_name); only a BROKEN priority source (3+ days without a successful check) is raised as a material exception.
